verdict.rationale: Community hands-on reports confirm Bitbucket's web UI has a source page for browsing repository files (comm-1, comm-5) and a commits view with history and a branch graph (comm-6). One user calls web source browsing slow and click-heavy, which is a usability complaint rather than a contradiction. Line-by-line blame is never evidenced, and no first-party docs describe these browsing features. Missing for 10: any evidence of line-by-line blame view, first-party documentation of file/history browsing, current (non-dated) corroboration.
